description: Retry a scene's failed AI video clip, optionally on another engine (still/kenburns drop the clip). AI clips require purchase; retrying a failed clip is free, while a pricier engine or a new take of a working clip may cost credits.

max_credits_cents.description: With use_credits: the amount the user agreed to, in cents (the cost_cents you were quoted). If the call would cost more, it asks again instead of charging.

project.description: Project id, 8-character id prefix, or exact project name

use_credits.description: Pay from the user's credits when the call needs it: $0.50 for a storyboard beyond today's free ones, or AI clips beyond what the purchase covers (the credits_confirm_required error says how much). Only set true after the user agreed to spend that amount.

name: d2v_retry_clip
title: Retry AI clip
